script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage does not say Jeremiah's hand will get tired.
It assumes the words are not for hiding and asserts that writing in a book rules out hiding them. The passage gives no such purpose.
Saying he has been in a locked drawer adds a detail not given in his backstory.
The passage does not mention Babylon or say the stay there looked very long.
Saying possessing means they stay goes beyond the promise that they will possess the land.
The oven-timer joke does not match the terror in the passage: remembering nothing is in the oven is not a situation of comparable alarm.
Calling service to the king of Babylon the old arrangement adds a fact not stated in this passage.
It guesses what threw this particular baker off, which Papa Dorin has not been told.
The promise of quiet and ease does not say all heavy work will be behind Jacob.
The passage calls them lovers but does not say the people counted on them.
The lovers having forgotten the people does not establish that no one is left who could pay anything.
It identifies the lovers as allies and claims they are not asking anybody for anything. The passage says neither.
“Not even close” is a negative, dismissive assessment of the baker's answer.
This passage does not say there was plenty of weeping before the promised celebration.
A leader arising from among their own does not establish that he cannot come from Babylon.
The hat joke makes the LORD's furious storm into a joke and places Papa Dorin in its path.
The verse names the wicked but does not say prophets cannot be among them or establish that Jeremiah can keep writing through the storm.
The verse does not say exiles cannot be among the wicked targeted by the whirlwind.
